examples.title: T3 test selection
examples.description: The focused host module run completed 238 sites with 153 survivors. Broader browser tests already cover some of those behaviors. A finding caused by excluding those tests is a selection gap, not proof that T3 lacks a test.

examples.title: SDK dogfooding
examples.description: Inspection of twenty SDK survivors identified eleven public-behavior test gaps. Direct controls confirmed that the old eleven tests pass every observed mutation and the strengthened eighteen tests fail each one. Ordinary exceptions remain runtime evidence under the conservative protocol.
